title: Five ways to add ~5g fibre to breakfast (real numbers)
caption:
You're tracking protein. Now look at the number most people ignore.

Five breakfast upgrades, each adding ~5g fibre:
1 tbsp chia seeds +4g
2 tbsp milled flaxseed +4g
50g jumbo oats +5g
100g raspberries +6g
30g oat bran +5g

24g added before you've cooked anything. Most adults should average 30g fibre a day (NHS).
